notes.title: Exciting News: Multiplayer Support Arrives! Get ready to Dive into the Action
notes.content:
🚀 Exciting News: Multiplayer Support Arrives!

[b]Multiplayer support is about to arrive[/b] almost right after the initial release for Space Ops Arcade! Get ready to team up, challenge friends, and dominate the competition. 
This marks a significant milestone for the game as the game has been rebuilt from the ground up, enhancing every aspect it to simplify new mechanics introduction, weapons, levels and gamemodes.
Since the initial release on Google Play of the game, altough who played before won't notice any difference despite better graphics on the Steam version, the game has been significally improved code wise, making bugs almost inexistent.

Being the focus the [b]Early Access[/b] release around March or April, the game will first be released with a brand new Survival Level, and will temporarily not carry on the original Survival Level from the Mobile version.

[b]Multiplayer Details[/b]: Even tought Multiplayer support comes automatically packed in the game has the game has been rebuilt for it, to be extremely sure that everything will work smoothly, it will be released in a subsequent update not too far from the launch.
Once the game is perfectly stable to be released on Google Play, it is expected that the players will be able to play with PC users aswell.

[b]About the Mobile Version Future[/b]: Aside from who had the game installed before, people installing the game on Google Play right now might experience issues and the game might not start.
On that side please allow more time as to understand how to keep the game supported on Mobile and expect the graphics to not be as impactful as on the Steam version.

[b]Other Platforms Release Plans[/b]: As of now there is no plan to release on ANY of the Apple systems.
And news for Linux will come much more later, as a the time to maintain the game on Google Play is really resource taking.

If you wish to support the game please refer to the related links.

As always remember that supporting trough buying the game or other means will help a lot for future works and eventually speed up the release and everything as this game and other content is brought to you by a [b]Solo Developer[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2674480
